meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检测已有的 OpenClaw 安装，读取并总结其配置，引导你逐步迁移到 NanoClaw v2。它会与你讨论迁移内容，先展示改动再执行，凭据只显示首尾4位，并创建迁移状态文件记录进度。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”“import from openclaw”等迁移相关语句时触发。

say.text: 把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
从 OpenClaw 导入我的身份和定时任务
say.note: 会检查安装并逐项迁移

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁过来

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects an OpenClaw install, reads its config, and guides migration to NanoClaw v2. It discusses what to move, shows changes before applying, masks credentials, and keeps a migration-state.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw", or similar migration-related phrases.

say_en.text: Import my identity and scheduled tasks from OpenClaw
say_en.note: Detects the install and migrates item by item
Claude will discover then ask your choices
